title: Sistem Pengurusan Program
summary: Manages participants across multiple programmes, with self-registration.
body:
A programme management system: one web application for managing participants across multiple programmes.

Participants can register themselves.

highlights.title: Many programmes, one system
highlights.text: Participants are managed per programme from a single application.

highlights.title: Self-registration
highlights.text: People sign themselves up for a programme and no one has to enter them by hand.
